senses.gloss: (b. h.) to break, separate; to untie, loosen; to unload.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 138a:15">Sabb. 138ᵃ</cite> <he>וילון … ומותר לפוֹרְקוֹ</he> it is permitted (on the Sabbath) to stretch a curtain and also to untie (remove) it. Ib.ᵇ top.

Y. Shebi. III, beg. 34ᶜ לא יִפְרוֹק וכ׳, v. מִשְׁפֶּלֶת. [Ib. לא יַפְרִיק Hif., v. infra.] Cant. R. to I, 5 טוענת ופוֹרֶקֶת she loads (becomes pregnant) and unloads (delivers); a. fr.—Trnsf. to redeem, deliver.
Gen. R. s. 44 אני פוֹרְקָן I shall redeem them; a. e.—פ׳ עול to untie the yoke, cast off an obligation.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 3:5">Ab. III, 5</cite>, v. <cite ref="P00240"><he>עוֹל</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:4">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 4</cite> <he>פָּרְקוּ מהם עול וכ׳</he> they cast off the heavenly yoke, and made flesh and blood rule over them; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 25 <he>אינן פּוֹרְקִין יראה</he> they do not cast off the fear (of having lost the divine grace through their sins); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 765:5">Yalk. Num. 765</cite> <he>אין פורקין יראה מהם</he>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:32">Num. R. s. 19</cite> <he>אין פּוֹרְקִים ביראה</he> (corr. acc.).—Part. pass. <cite ref="Q01726"><he>פָּרוּק</he></cite>; f. <cite ref="Q01727"><he>פְּרוּקָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>פְּרוּקִים</he>, <he>פְּרוּקִין</he>; <he>פְּרוּקוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 3:5:2">Y. B. Kam. III, 3ᵈ</cite> <he>אחד פ׳ ואחד טעון וכ׳</he> if (on meeting on the road) one animal is without a load, and the other is laden, the unladen must make room for the laden; <he>היו שניהן … פ׳</he> if both are laden or both unladen.
Ib. שתיהן פ׳ if both wagons are without a load; a. fr.—Esp. to help to unload an animal broken down under its burden (Ex. XXIII, 5).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:10">B. Mets. II, 10</cite> <he>מצוה … לִפְרוֹק</he>, v. <cite ref="I00616"><he>טָעַן</he> II</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 2:10">Ib.</cite> <he>אם רצונך לפרוק פְּרוֹק</he> if thou desirest to unload, do so (without my assistance); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to sever, strip; to take off, release; to take apart.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 2:2">Shebi. II, 2</cite> <he>מְפָרְקִין</he> you may release (trees in the Sabbatical year); Y. ib. 33ᵈ top <he>מפ׳ בעלין</he> ‘release’ refers to (a too luxuriant growth of) leaves.
<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 2:5">Ukts. II, 5</cite> <he>התחיל לְפָרֵק</he> when he has begun to strip (vegetables).
<cite ref="Tosefta Uktsin 2:13">Tosef. ib. II, 13</cite> <he>התחיל לפרק באגוזים</he> when he has begun to strip nuts (of their burrs).
<cite ref="Shabbat 88a:7">Sabb. 88ᵃ</cite> <he>ירדו … ופֵירְקוּם</he> one hundred and twenty myriads of angels of destruction came down and took them (the crowns) off their heads.

<cite ref="Shabbat 88a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>בחורב … פֵּרְקוּ</he> (Rashi <he>פירקו</he>) at Horeb they loaded (angels put crowns on their heads), and at Horeb they unloaded (angels took their crowns off).

<cite ref="Menachot 8a:3">Men. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 9b:5">9ᵇ</cite> <he>עד שלא פֵרְקָהּ</he> before he took it (the pile of the show bread) apart. Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ top <he>מעמירו ומְפָרְקוֹ</he> put it (the Tabernacle) up and broke it up again; <he>העמידו ולא פירקו</he> put it up and did not break it up again; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 13">Num. R. s. 13</cite>, beg.; Sifra Tsav, Milluim, Par. 1 end.—Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵇ bot. <he>מְפָרְקִין את המנעול וכ׳</he> you may take the shoe off the block. Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ, v. <cite ref="Q01432"><he>פַּצִּים</he></cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 95a:3">Sabb. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>חולב חייב משום מפרק</he> one milking (on the Sabbath) is guilty of an act resembling unloading; <cite ref="Ketubot 60a:11">Keth. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>יונק מפרק כלאחר יד</he> releasing the cow by sucking is unloading in an unusual way (v. <cite ref="A01046"><he>אַחַר</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13:2">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> <he>עמד ופֵרְקוּם לישראל</he> he rose and took them off the back of the gentiles, and put them on Israel.—

Sabb. 156ᵃ לְפָרֵק to take food from before one animal and place it before another, Rashi; [Tosaf.: to empty from vessel to vessel in order to procure a thorough mixture; other defin., v. Ar. s. v.].—Part. pass. מְפוֹרָק

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 33a">B. Mets. 33ᵃ</cite> (ref. to Ex. l. c.) ‘under its burden’, <he>ולא מפ׳</he> but not when it is unloaded (and the owner requires assistance to load it again). Ib. <he>לא מפ׳ בחנם</he> when it is unloaded, one need not assist in loading without remuneration.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: taken apart, broken up. Tanḥ. P’kudé 11 והיה מונח ומפ׳ וכ׳ and it (the Tabernacle) lay in parts (uncombined) during &c.
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: to be taken apart, broken up. Y. Yoma l. c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:1">Sabb. XVII, 1</cite> <he>אע״פ שנִתְפָּרְקוּ</he> although the doors are detached (when the piece of furniture is moved).

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 2</cite> <he>נִתְפָּרְקָה זו וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (missing in eds.) if the blades of scissors are separated, each may become unclean for itself; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36:7">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:24">Gen. IX, 24</cite>) <he>נתפ׳ יינו מעליו</he> the load of his wine was taken from him (he became sober).

senses.gloss: to be loose, movable like a link or joint (v. פֶּרֶק).
units: <cite ref="Yoma 72a:11">Yoma 72ᵃ</cite> <he>מִתְפָּרְקִין ואין וכ׳</he> they (the bars in the ring) were movable but could not slip off.

<cite ref="Niddah 9a:30">Nidd. 9ᵃ</cite> (of a woman after confinement) <he>איבריה מתפרקין וכ׳</he> her limbs are loose (shaky), and her full strength does not return to her before &c.; <cite ref="Bekhorot 6b:9">Bekh. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>איבריה מתפרקין הימנה</he> she feels as tho’ her limbs were dropping off.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 708:12">Yalk. Num. 708</cite> <he>תהא מִתְפָּרֶקֶת איברים איברים</he> she shall lose limb after limb; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מתרפקת</he> (corr. acc.); a. e.—[<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 986:31">Yalk. Cant. 986</cite> <he>מתפרקות</he> some ed., read: <he>מתרפקות</he>, v. <cite ref="T00960"><he>רָפַק</he></cite>.]

senses.gloss: to be out of joint, dislocated, sprained.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 22:6">Sabb. XXII, 6</cite> <he>מי שנִפְרְקָה ידו וכ׳</he> he who sprained his arm or foot.

senses.gloss: to be removed. Tosef. ib. XIII (XIV), 5 שיִפָּרְקוּ ed. Zuck. (Var. שימחו) that they be removed (cut out).—[Hif. הִפְרִיק as Kal and Pi.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Berakhot 2:7">Tosef. Ber. II, 7</cite> <he>שיַפְרִיק</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>שיְפָרֵק</he>). Y. Shebi. III, beg. 34ᶜ, v. supra; prob. to be read: <he>יְפָרֵיק</he>.]
